# GOV.UK fixtures

Fixture Items for the recorded runs of *reading an Item* and *placing a Fact*: eight documents the Prime Minister's Office, 10 Downing Street published on GOV.UK between 10 and 16 October 2026, each as the GOV.UK Content API (`https://www.gov.uk/api/content/<path>`) returned it on 25 October 2026. Placing places their recorded readings in the order they were published. The government's response to the US-Russia agreement is there as a reaction, which placing must make a Development in no Story.

| File | Document |
|---|---|
| `pm-speech-in-scotland-16-october-2026.json` | PM speech in Scotland (Motherwell), 16 October 2026 |
| `prime-minister-makes-offer-to-holyrood-to-work-together-to-empower-scottish-regions.json` | Press release on the same offer, 15 October 2026 |
| `pm-statement-to-the-house-of-commons-12-october-2026.json` | PM statement to the House of Commons, 12 October 2026 |
| `pm-meeting-with-president-zelenskyy-of-ukraine-14-october-2026.json` | Readout of the PM's meeting with President Zelenskyy, 14 October 2026 |
| `president-zelenskyy-to-visit-downing-street.json` | Press release ahead of the visit, 13 October 2026 |
| `great-british-railways-takes-shape-as-hq-and-apprenticeship-scheme-confirmed.json` | Press release on Great British Railways, 14 October 2026 |
| `appointment-of-lord-lieutenant-of-county-tyrone-15-october-2026.json` | Appointment notice, 15 October 2026 |
| `uk-government-response-to-agreement-between-us-and-russia-9-october.json` | Government response to the US-Russia agreement, 10 October 2026 |
